hero.lead: Tampa to the clinic is about four hours by car across Alligator Alley, or just over an hour by air. Drive down Monday, 20 natural veneers made in our own lab, drive home Thursday with a 5-year written warranty.
hero.alt: Alligator Alley across the Everglades at sunrise, seen from the passenger seat
hero.caption: Tampa → Westchester, Miami · about 4 h by car via I-75 · free parking at the clinic

intro: From Tampa Bay it is a straight shot: I-75 south, east across Alligator Alley, about four hours with free parking at the clinic, or just over an hour by air. The treatment is [porcelain veneers](/porcelain-veneers-miami) in multilayer zirconia from the [lab one floor above your doctor](/custom-lab), at {veneerPrice} per tooth or {price} for the 20-veneer [Smile Design](/smile-design-miami). Hotels, airport and what to pack are on the [out-of-state patients page](/out-of-state-patients).

gettingHere.title: Getting from Tampa to the clinic
gettingHere.aside: General guidance from the clinic. Check times with your map app and the carrier on the day; we do not sell travel.
gettingHere.alt: Calle Ocho in the early morning, the street the clinic is on

items.d: About 280 miles: I-75 south, then east across Alligator Alley. About four hours.
TPA to MIA is about 1 h 10 min in the air, on American or Southwest.
If you fly, MIA is 15 minutes by Uber or Lyft. We text you the pickup spot.
Leave by 6:00 am Monday to beat Miami's late-morning traffic. Parking at the clinic is free.

itinerary.title: A sample Monday-to-Thursday from Tampa, by car
itinerary.intro: Times are examples. If you fly, only the Monday morning and the Thursday afternoon change; the three visits are the same.

days.d: Drive down, park at the clinic. Exam, scans and the design preview you approve.
Minimal preparation, then temporaries in the shape you approved. Afternoon free.

days.t: Free day while the lab finishes
days.d: Your veneers are finished by hand in the lab upstairs. No visit.
Shade check, bonding, bite adjusted, warranty in writing. Then the drive home.
days.time: Visit 3 about 9:00 am to 11:00 am. Leave Miami about 12:30 pm, home in Tampa around 4:30 pm.

itinerary.note: The numbness from Visit 2 wears off in a couple of hours and does not affect driving.

cost.title: What it costs to come from Tampa
cost.body: Treatment is priced from the [published packages](/veneers-cost-miami) and confirmed in writing before you book. Travel is yours; for a driver the extra cost is fuel, tolls and the hotel nights.

lines.label: Smile Design, 20 porcelain veneers
lines.note: Preview, cleaning, X-rays and the {warrantyYears}-year written warranty included

lines.label: Hotel, two to four nights
lines.note: Hilton and Marriott within 10 minutes; you book directly from the list we send

lines.label: Fuel and tolls, or the TPA–MIA flight
lines.note: Not included. Parking at the clinic is free

cost.footnote: Monthly plans through six financing partners with a soft credit check. Your coordinator helps with the application before you book the hotel.

items.q: Can I drive home to Tampa the same day as delivery?
items.a: Yes. Delivery on Thursday morning takes about two hours and nothing about it stops you driving straight after. Leave after a soft lunch and you are across the Alley and home by late afternoon.

Most Tampa patients drive: four hours door to door, free parking, and the car for the free Wednesday. Flying is just over an hour in the air but about the same once you add two airports. Either way the three visits do not change.

items.q: Can I go home on the free Wednesday?
items.a: You can; a few Tampa patients do, and come back for Thursday morning. It is eight hours of driving for one night in your own bed, so most stay at the partner rate and use the day.

items.q: Can I drive after Visit 2 with the numbness?
items.a: The local anesthetic wears off within a couple of hours and does not affect your ability to drive. If you would rather not, the partner hotels are within 10 minutes of the clinic and a rideshare is simple.

items.q: What if something needs adjusting once I am back in Tampa?
items.a: Small adjustments are covered by the {warrantyYears}-year warranty at any dentist near you, and there is a video check-in two weeks after delivery. For anything beyond a polish, a four-hour drive to the lab that made the veneers is the simplest route.

items.q: Why come to Miami when there are clinics in Tampa?
items.a: Compare the same five things in writing: material, number of teeth, veneer or crown per tooth, total, and warranty. What is different here is the lab in the building, which is why the whole set is done in one week and the shade is checked on you by the ceramist. The prices are public.
